prior_observation: The r4 screenshot showed the basemap without clearly visible River points although the planned PMTiles tile-data ranges succeeded and the official layer checkbox was checked.
steps: Preserve the existing default-view screenshot and initial actual layer-control checkbox states.
Use exactly three clicks on the visible MapLibre zoom-in button and save a zoomed screenshot.
Use the official visible layer-control checkbox named exactly River input display tiles: record its checked state, uncheck it and save a screenshot, then check it again and save a screenshot.

After each view change, allow planned Source requests to pass the unchanged exact-object, ranged-206, CORS, range-size and byte-budget checks, then wait for Source activity to settle before saving the image.
expected_observation: At least one saved view should show actual River point features clearly enough for manual visual review. The automated harness records states, requests and images; it does not self-assert that any image meets this visual expectation.
interpretation: The default view remains part of the evidence and is not overwritten.
If points appear only after zooming, the initial view may be too broad for legible low-zoom thinning.
If points disappear when the checkbox is unchecked and return when rechecked, the visible overlay is connected to the expected UI control.
A missing or ambiguous visual result remains unresolved and requires manual review; it does not authorize changing data, styles or catalog metadata.
unchanged_gates: This is a selected River diagnostic, not the five-collection acceptance gate.
All Source plan, cross-product, MIME, HEAD, range, Content-Range, CORS, tile-data, transfer-budget and failure rules remain unchanged.
No request may be substituted or exempted, and every diagnostic screenshot is still pending human visual review.
